common.style_usage: the exact style of these Stardew Valley buff icons: 16 by 16 pixel rounded tiles with a darker coloured border, flat coloured backgrounds and one bold symbol each

light.description: a Stardew Valley buff icon, exactly 16 by 16 pixels, filling the whole square: a rounded square tile with a darker coloured border (not black), a flat coloured background, and one bold simple symbol in the middle with a bright highlight, like the game's own buff icons: a bright golden yellow sun with short rays and a white highlight, on a light sky blue tile
